clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire's volunteer militia faces restless dead rising across Duskwood. Commander Althea Ebonlocke sends travelers into the haunted barrows to hold the skeletal horrors back. The struggle helps keep Darkshire from falling to the darkness.

Duskwood's graveyards have grown unnaturally restless as the forest sinks into twilight. Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads Darkshire's volunteer militia, The Night Watch, against an endless siege. With no aid from Stormwind, her forces are stretched thin. Animated skeletons and other horrors rise from the earth and threaten the eastern settlements, so the militia calls on able travelers to enter the deadlands.

Two places draw the militia's attention: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, just south of town, and Raven Hill Graveyard, far to the west. Skeletons pull themselves from forgotten tombs and shallow graves beside the roads, stirred by dark magic lingering in the forest's shadows. Cutting them down gives Darkshire's beleaguered citizens room to breathe, but the battle against this entrenched evil never ends.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest! If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors. There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. The undead must be driven from Duskwood!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The people of Darkshire thank you, friend. You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
